title: Umuhamagaro Udacogora ku Kuri
intro: Intumwa ihagarara yonyine mu bwoko bw’abagome, ibahamagara ku Mana Imwe y’Ukuri mu gihe bakomeje kwihambira ku bigirwamana by’ibinyoma. Uyu muhanuzi afite izina risubiramo ibisobanuro bikomeye—'ushaka uburinzi'—ariko ahabwa kwangwa no guhakana gusa. Binyuze mu kwemezwa no kuburirwa mu buryo bworoheje, uyu bugingo butwara ubutumwa bw’Imana isi ubwayo izatsinda burundu. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu uhamye uhagarariye imwe mu nkuru za kera cyane mu byanditswe bya Islam?
clues: Ubwoko bwanjye bwasengaga imana nyinshi, mu gihe nanjye nabuhamagariraga gukorera Uwaremye ijuru n'isi.
Nahagaze imbere y'ubwoko bwanjye maze ntangaza ko nta ngororano nzasaba kuri bo—icyifuzo cyanjye cyonyine cyari ukubayobora mu gukiranuka.
Umuyaga ukomeye woherejwe ku bantu banjye nk'igihano cy'Imana, umuyaga Korowani ivugaho mu bwinshi no mu buryo bw'abagore.
Bitandukanye n'abahanuzi bamwe na bamwe, ntabwo nahawe umugore cyangwa abana bavugwa cyane mu nkuru yanjye, kuko intego yanjye yari uguhamagara abantu banjye bonyine.
Izina ryanjye rifite ibisobanuro byimbitse—bifitanye isano n'igitekerezo cyo kurindwa no guhungirwa umuntu ashaka.
Abaturage banjye bari bazwiho ijambo ryihariye ry’ikibaya bari batuyemo, kandi ubutaka bwabo bwavugwaga nabi cyane kubera ko nta bimera byari bifite.
